title: Local model and context
description: Save Ollama context and output limits. Default model changes apply to new chats.
minimum: Local models require at least 64K (65,536 tokens). 32K leaves insufficient room for the startup prompt and task work.
evidence: Recorded trial: qwen3:30b-a3b-instruct-2507-q4_K_M, RTX 4090 24 GB, 98,304 tokens. About 18% CPU offload; peak context 89.9%. This is not a performance guarantee. The 64K profile is not tested. Real-task validation at 64K and 98,304 tokens belongs to release validation.
variant: Create a variant with this context
variantHelp: Only when saving with this checked, create an Ollama variant with num_ctx. The original stays unchanged. An existing same-name variant is updated. Otherwise only the app declaration changes.
defaultHelp: Leave unchecked to keep the existing default model.
verified: Declared context fits the observed runtime setting. This does not guarantee memory allocation or task success.
mismatch: The app declaration and Ollama settings differ. Check the server URL, num_ctx and loaded context.
unverified: Runtime context is unverified. Trained context alone does not establish the runtime size.
failed: Could not process local model settings.
invalid: Choose a model and enter integer token counts. Context must be at least 64K (65,536 tokens). Maximum output must be smaller than context.
